title: Reaction heat from an amount
statement:
A reaction has $\Delta H=-248$ kJ as written and consumes 2 mol of A per written reaction. At constant pressure, find the signed heat for $[$n]$ mol A.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: The tabulated heat corresponds to two moles of A.

hints: Convert moles A to reaction extent.
The tabulated heat corresponds to two moles of A.
solution: The reaction extent is $[$n]/2$ on the written basis. The heat is $-248([$n]/2)$ kJ.
